import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Final

import pytest

NOTES_DIR: Final[str] = "notes"


def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str:
    """Return the text of the first name in `names` readable as a file inside NOTES_DIR.

    Each name is resolved relative to the NOTES_DIR directory under the current
    working directory. Names are untrusted: any name that resolves to a path
    outside NOTES_DIR (via "..", an absolute path, or a symlink) must be skipped.
    Missing, unreadable, or non-file entries are skipped. Returns "" when no
    name yields readable text.
    """
    base = Path(NOTES_DIR).resolve()
    for name in names:
        try:
            target = (base / name).resolve()
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError):
            continue
        if not target.is_relative_to(base):
            continue
        try:
            if not target.is_file():
                continue
            return target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue
    return ""


def test_returns_first_readable(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / NOTES_DIR
    notes.mkdir()
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["a.txt", "b.txt"]) == "alpha"


def test_skips_missing(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / NOTES_DIR
    notes.mkdir()
    (notes / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["missing.txt", "b.txt"]) == "beta"


def test_empty_list_returns_empty(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / NOTES_DIR).mkdir()
    assert first_readable([]) == ""


def test_none_readable_returns_empty(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / NOTES_DIR).mkdir()
    assert first_readable(["x.txt", "y.txt"]) == ""


def test_directory_entry_is_skipped(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / NOTES_DIR
    (notes / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    (notes / "c.txt").write_text("gamma", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["sub", "c.txt"]) == "gamma"


def test_parent_traversal_is_blocked(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / NOTES_DIR
    notes.mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("secret", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "ok.txt").write_text("hi", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt", "ok.txt"]) == "hi"


def test_nested_traversal_is_blocked(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / NOTES_DIR
    (notes / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("secret", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["sub/../../secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_absolute_path_is_blocked(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / NOTES_DIR
    notes.mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("secret", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable([str(secret)]) == ""


def test_symlink_escape_is_blocked(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / NOTES_DIR
    notes.mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("secret", encoding="utf-8")
    os.symlink(secret, notes / "link.txt")
    assert first_readable(["link.txt"]) == ""
